title: Lanthanide N,N-Dimethylaminodiboranates as a New Class of Highly Volatile Chemical Vapor Deposition Precursors

material_class.structural_family: monomeric 12-coordinate DMADB thf adduct (late/small-metal family; Y grouped with Dy and Er)

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the shared thf route used for Y and Pr–Nd, Sm–Lu: anhydrous YCl3 was treated with 3 equiv of Na(H3BNMe2BH3) in thf, and the product was isolated by pentane extraction and crystallization (series yields 51–71%). Operations were under vacuum or argon (Schlenk). Full per-metal quantities are not given in the main text (representative procedure is for Sm, 6a). Crystals for XRD were grown by sublimation.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Extraction and crystallization from pentane; XRD crystals grown by sublimation.

material_class.structural_family: monomeric 13-coordinate DMADB thf adduct (cubic I23; similar to the Pca21 series)

synthesis.procedure: The chloride route in thf did not give pentane-extractable 2a. It can be prepared from LaI3 and 3 equiv of Na(H3BNMe2BH3) in thf. The reported isolation used the base-free complex: thf (15 mL) was added to La(H3BNMe2BH3)3 (0.10 g, 0.28 mmol), the clear solution was stirred 15 min and evaporated under vacuum, and the white residue was extracted with pentane (40 mL), filtered, concentrated to 10 mL, and stored at −20 °C to give large cubic crystals. All operations under vacuum or argon.

material_class.structural_family: monomeric DMADB thf adduct

synthesis.procedure: To a suspension of CeI3 (0.95 g, 1.8 mmol) in thf (20 mL) at 0 °C was added sodium N,N-dimethylaminodiboranate (0.52 g, 5.5 mmol) in thf (20 mL). The mixture was stirred at 0 °C for 15 min, warmed to room temperature, stirred 15 h, and evaporated under vacuum. The sticky white solid was extracted with pentane (65 mL), filtered, concentrated to about 18 mL, and cooled to −20 °C (0.49 g of colorless blocks); the mother liquor concentrated to 6 mL and cooled to −20 °C gave a further 0.085 g. The chloride route in thf gave only low yield (<13%). Schlenk/argon or vacuum.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Evaporated to dryness; pentane extraction, filtration, concentration, and cooling to −20 °C.

material_class.structural_family: monomeric 13-coordinate DMADB thf adduct, isomorphous Pca21 series

synthesis.procedure: To a suspension of SmCl3 (0.30 g, 1.2 mmol) in thf (20 mL) at 0 °C was added sodium N,N-dimethylaminodiboranate (0.33 g, 3.5 mmol) in thf (20 mL). The light-yellow mixture was stirred at 0 °C for 15 min, warmed to room temperature, stirred 15 h, and evaporated under vacuum to a sticky ivory solid. Extraction with pentane (2 × 15 mL), filtration, concentration to about 15 mL, and cooling to −20 °C gave 0.18 g of ivory crystals; the mother liquor concentrated to 7 mL and cooled to −20 °C gave a further 0.11 g. Schlenk/argon or vacuum. XRD crystals of 6a were obtained from pentane.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Vacuum evaporation; pentane extraction, filtration, concentration, and cooling to −20 °C.

material_class.structural_family: dinuclear base-free DMADB complex; each Y 12-coordinate with two chelating and two bridging DMADB ligands

synthesis.procedure: Base-free complexes were obtained either by grinding anhydrous LnCl3 with 3 equiv of Na(H3BNMe2BH3) (yields variable) or, preferably, by sublimation of the thf adduct under dynamic vacuum, which loses thf. Y is in the most volatile late-metal group (sublimation across the series 65–125 °C at 10^−2 Torr). XRD crystals of 1b were grown by sublimation. Compound-specific masses are not given in the main text. Schlenk/vacuum.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: grinding with steel balls or vacuum sublimation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Sublimation; single crystals of 1b grown by sublimation.

synthesis.procedure: Sublimation of Er(H3BNMe2BH3)3(thf) (12a) under dynamic vacuum removes coordinated thf and affords 12b, identified by loss of the thf 1H NMR resonances. synthesis.procedure: Sublimation of the lutetium thf adduct (0.32 g, 0.69 mmol) at 65–75 °C and 10^−2 Torr afforded white microcrystals of Lu(H3BNMe2BH3)3. The experimental heading numbers this product 14b, but Table 1 and the FI-MS table assign lutetium as 15b (14 is ytterbium); the analytical and MS data are for Lu. Schlenk/vacuum.

material_class.structural_family: distorted La4O4 cubane; each La bound to three bridging hydroxides and two chelating DMADB ligands, with one B–H of each DMADB bridging to an adjacent La; pentane solvate

synthesis.procedure: Crystals of the partial hydrolysis product [La(H3BNMe2BH3)2(OH)]4 (16) were obtained adventitiously and are presumed to form from Ln(H3BNMe2BH3)3(thf) and water, releasing H2 and (NMe2)B2H5. No reagent masses, water amount, time, or yield are given. Crystals used for XRD were grown from pentane. The deposited formula includes two pentane molecules.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystallized from pentane; crystals mounted in Paratone-N or Krytox oil and cooled to −80 °C for diffraction.
